metadata.description: Plugins for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot: my-react (React/TS rule skills that pair with my-workflow), my-flutter (Flutter/Dart rule skills that pair with my-workflow), my-workflow (language-agnostic spec-driven workflow by task kind, led by drive-spec with optional agents), my-invest (financial advisor and analyst for US stocks, cited). Install any subset with setup.py.

plugins.name: my-react
plugins.description: React and TypeScript knowledge for coding agents: design, implement, test, review and figma skills of rules, with no process. Use alone or with my-workflow, whose steps and agents pick them up by stack.

plugins.name: my-flutter
plugins.description: Flutter and Dart knowledge for coding agents: design, implement, riverpod, test and review skills of rules, with no process. Use alone or with my-workflow, whose steps and agents pick them up by stack.

plugins.name: my-workflow
plugins.description: Language-agnostic spec-driven workflow that keeps a human in control of agent-written code: drive-spec decides the kind of task (feature, bug, improvement), keeps specs/<task>/workflow.yaml and settles the requirements (or a diagnosis), the design and the plan with you through the spec-* skills, then delegates tests, code and review to the spec-tester, spec-implementer and spec-code-reviewer agents, with spec-design-reviewer on your yes; stable ids trace every criterion to code and to evidence of its behaviour, a script decides the gates and writes the coverage report, and you approve the requirements, the design and any workaround; standalone skills: rephrase, discuss, audit-truth (a unit atlas of existing code) and three design skills; code-auditor builds an atlas. Maps your installed stack skills to each step.

plugins.name: my-invest
plugins.description: Financial advisor for a beginner in US stocks and funds: reads what the question asks (one stock, your holdings from a broker CSV, a sector, the market, or a mix), runs six analysis dimensions (SEC fundamentals, a three-scenario DCF, price statistics, macro and politics, industry, sentiment) through nine single-purpose scripts over one SQLite database, and answers result-first with three options (conservative, moderate, aggressive) in tables shaped by the question, each with a confidence score built from evidence, agreement and its own track record against the index; a daily digest skill for your holdings; every figure linked to its source; Markdown in the chat, an HTML page on disk. US-listed only; holdings never stored.
